narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience on the legal history and classification of claw machines in Taiwan. It explains the distinction between 'gaming machines' and 'vending machines' and how the 'guaranteed prize' mechanism was introduced to bypass gambling regulations, concluding with a financial warning to viewers.
